root_text: 1/ 🦠 what is HMPV? Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a respiratory virus identified in 2001. It usually causes mild cold like symptoms but can lead to severe illness in vulnerable groups. Recently, cases have emerged in India, raising concern
